65978.commentary: (SNa) vatasīlabaddhā'ti ajavatakukkuravat'ādīhi ca vatehi tādiseh'eva ca sīlehi baddhā.

examples.text: taṇh'ādhipannā vatasīlabaddhā, lūkhaṃ tapaṃ vassasataṃ carantā, cittañ'ca nesaṃ na sammā vimuttaṃ, hīn'attharūpā na pāraṅ'gamā te.
yaṃ tvaṃ apāyesi bahū manusse, pipāsite ghammani samparete, taṃ te purāṇaṃ vatasīlavattaṃ, suttappabuddho'va anussarāmi.

65980.commentary: (DNa) so vat'ass'āhaṃ puññāni kareyyan'ti so vata ahaṃ evarūpo assaṃ, yadi puññāni kareyyan'ti attho. so vatassa'ssan'ti'pi pāṭho, ayam'ev'attho.
65980.notes: alternatively, vata + ssu + ahaṃ, taking kareyyaṃ as opt reflx 1st sg

examples.text: so vat'ass'āhaṃ puññāni kareyyaṃ. yaṃnūn'āhaṃ kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajeyyan'ti.
tasmā hi dhīrañ'ca paññañ'ca bahussutañ'ca, dhorayhasīlaṃ vatavantam'ariyaṃ, taṃ tādisaṃ sappurisaṃ sumedhaṃ, bhajetha nakkhattapathaṃ'va candimā.
akkodhanaṃ vatavantaṃ, sīlavantaṃ anussadaṃ, dantaṃ antimasārīraṃ, tam'ahaṃ brūmi brāhmaṇaṃ.
sādhu vat'āyasmantaṃ'y'eva sāriputtaṃ paṭibhātu etassa bhāsitassa attho'ti.
addasā kho aññataro bhikkhu paṭibhānakūṭe mahantaṃ papātaṃ. disvāna bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, mahā vat'āyaṃ, bhante, papāto subhayānako, bhante, papāto.
kicchaṃ vat'āyaṃ loko āpanno, jāyati ca jīyati ca mīyati ca cavati ca upapajjati ca, atha ca pan'imassa dukkhassa nissaraṇaṃ nappajānāti jarāmaraṇassa.

65984.meaning1: oh no I; indeed I; wow I

examples.text: yaṃ vat'āhaṃ aññesu samaṇabrāhmaṇesu okāsakammamattam'pi n'ālatthaṃ taṃ me idaṃ samaṇena gotamena okāsakammaṃ katan'ti. attamano pamudito udaggo pītisomanassajāto bhagavantaṃ pañhaṃ apucchi.
idha bhikkhu ekaccassa evaṃ hoti, ahu vata me, taṃ vata me n'atthi, siyā vata me, taṃ vat'āhaṃ na labhāmī'ti.

65986.meaning1: observing a practice; undertaking a certain behaviour; acting like
65986.meaning2: having the habit of, acting like

examples.text: atha kho puṇṇo ca koliyaputto govatiko acelo ca seniyo kukkuravatiko yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkamiṃsu, upasaṅkamitvā puṇṇo koliyaputto govatiko bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekam'antaṃ nisīdi.

65987.commentary: (VINa) bhaddavatikā'ti eko gāmo, so bhaddikāya vatiyā samannāgatattā etaṃ nāma labhi.

examples.text: ramaṇīyo vata, bho, bhūmibhāgo, pāsādiko ca vanasaṇḍo, nadī ca sandati setakā supatitthā ramaṇīyā, samantā ca gocaragāmo. alaṃ vat'idaṃ kulaputtassa padhān'atthikassa padhānāyā'ti.
bhaddakā vat'ime sunāparantakā manussā, subhaddakā vat'ime sunāparantakā manussā, yaṃ me na'y'ime pāṇinā pahāraṃ dentī'ti. evam'ettha, bhagavā, bhavissati, evam'ettha, sugata, bhavissatī'ti.

65990.commentary: (SNa) sambuddhimantaṃ vatinaṃ amaññī'ti, sammā buddhimā vatasampanno ayan'ti evaṃ maññamāno kappo tava antevāsiko ahosiṃ ahaṃ so tena samayenā'ti dasseti.

examples.text: kappo ca te baddhacaro ahosiṃ, sambuddhivantaṃ vatinaṃ amaññi, taṃ te purāṇaṃ vatasīlavattaṃ, suttappabuddho'va anussarāmī'ti.

65991.meaning1: custom; practice; way of life; behaviour

examples.text: saritvā pubbake yogī, tesaṃ vattam'anussaraṃ, kiñ'c'āpi pacchimo kālo, phuseyya amataṃ padaṃ.

paṭipadāya na saṇṭhātī'ti paṭipattiyaṃ na tiṭṭhati, vattaṃ ajānitvā apucchitabbaṭṭhāne pucchatī'ti attho. ayaṃ pañho nāma cetiy'aṅgaṇe pucchitena na kathetabbo, tathā bhikkhācāramagge gāmaṃ piṇḍāya caraṇakāle.

paṭipadāya na saṇṭhātī'ti paṭipattiyaṃ na tiṭṭhati, vattaṃ ajānitvā apucchitabbaṭṭhāne pucchatī'ti attho. ayaṃ pañho nāma cetiy'aṅgaṇe pucchitena na kathetabbo, tathā bhikkhācāramagge gāmaṃ piṇḍāya caraṇakāle.
tattha purimesu catūsu kiccesu idāni suriy'ālokassa atthitāya n'atthi, aparāni tīṇi bhikkhūnaṃ vattaṃ jānantehi bhikkhūhi katāni pariniṭṭhitāni honti.

65993.commentary: (MNa) vattasampanno'ti ācārasampanno. (JAa) vattasampanno'ti ghar'āvāsavattena vā rājavattena vā samannāgato.

examples.text: vāseṭṭho māṇavo evam'āha, yato kho, bho, sīlavā ca hoti vattasampanno ca, ettāvatā kho, bho, brāhmaṇo hotī'ti.

65994.meaning1: (gram) letter v; 37th letter of the alphabet; dento-labial semi-vowel

examples.text: tassa sāvakā na sussūsanti, na sotaṃ odahanti, na aññā cittaṃ upaṭṭhapenti, vokkamma ca satthusāsanā vattanti.
yehi tīhi dhammehi samannāgato bālo veditabbo te tayo dhamme abhinivajjetvā, yehi tīhi dhammehi samannāgato paṇḍito veditabbo te tayo dhamme samādāya vattissāmā'ti.

paṭhamaṃ pan'āvuso, jhānaṃ kati-aṅgikan'ti? paṭhamaṃ kho, āvuso, jhānaṃ pañc'aṅgikaṃ. idh'āvuso, paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ samāpannassa bhikkhuno vitakko ca vattati, vicāro ca pīti ca sukhañ'ca citt'ek'aggatā ca.
tena kho pana samayena kasibhāradvājassa brāhmaṇassa parivesanā vattati. atha kho bhagavā yena parivesanā ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā ekam'antaṃ aṭṭhāsi.

65998.commentary: (VINa) tasmā dhamme na vattāmī'ti yasmā evaṃ mayā rañño odano bhutto, aññe ca bahū lābhā laddhā, tasmā dhamme ahaṃ na vattāmi udare baddho hutvā, na dhammaṃ ajānanto.

examples.text: sālīnaṃ odano bhutto, sucimaṃs'ūpasecano, tasmā dhamme na vattāmi, dhammo ariyebhi vaṇṇito.

taṃ kiṃ maññasi, aggivessana, vatteyya rañño khattiyassa muddh'āvasittassa sakasmiṃ vijite vaso, ghātetāyaṃ vā ghātetuṃ, jāpetāyaṃ vā jāpetuṃ, pabbājetāyaṃ vā pabbājetuṃ, seyyathā'pi rañño pasenadissa kosalassa, seyyathā'pi vā pana rañño māgadhassa ajātasattussa vedehiputtassā'ti?
